FreetoShop is a browser-only, local-first editor under phased development. Workspace layout: `apps/web` (interaction, accessibility, PWA, view state; `workers/` is the browser-process boundary for long-running local ops), and packages `core-document`, `command-history`, `compositor`, `renderer`, `raster-engine`, `selection-engine`, `filter-engine`, `transform-engine`, `text-engine`, `file-codecs`, `persistence`, `benchmarks`, `pixel-storage`.

Key architectural facts:
- `core-document` owns serializable editor state, layer ordering, stable IDs, invertible affine layer transforms, validated edits, editable shape geometry/styles, line/cubic vector-path commands, text content/styles, ordered typed layer effects and nondestructive parameters, embedded smart-object source trees, ordered typed smart-filter state, nondestructive canvas geometry. Crop/Canvas Size change canvas bounds; translate only root-layer world placement; remap canvas-sized selection/channel data without trimming layer-local pixels/masks. Reveal All derives expanded rect from nested transformed renderable-layer bounds. Pixel layers own immutable sparse `TiledPixelStore`; patches replace only changed tiles; history may share unchanged resources. Raster masks use one-channel `TiledCoverageStore` with copy-on-write mask patches.
- `command-history` applies undoable commands and owns undo/redo history.
- `compositor` owns DOM-free premultiplied-alpha source-over equations, 20 separable + 6 RGB-vector professional blend modes, immutable/in-place same-sized surface composition.
- `renderer` turns document+viewport into Canvas 2D pixels; must not mutate document; rasterizes affine pixel/rectangle/ellipse/path/text layers, resolves clipping and group isolation, rasterizes local and document-space raster/vector masks (including masks over combined pass-through and isolated group results), recursively composites smarts.
- `apps/web` boundaries: components should not encode file formats or pixel algorithms. Shell delegates dialog lifecycle to `components/`, filter-command adaptation to `editor/filterOperations`, shared interaction contracts to `editor/types`, pure document/geometry helpers to `editor/model`; new editor behavior must extend these boundaries instead of growing `App.tsx`.

Current task: implement FreetoShop long-horizon engineering goal, starting with Milestone 1 — Clone Stamp foundation. Required behavior: Alt/Option-click establishes clone source with clear UI indication; pointer painting samples from source into destination using existing brush/raster workflow; aligned mode preserves source-to-destination offset across gesture/stroke segments; unaligned mode restarts sampling from source origin; clone sampling and destination writes use correct transformed-layer coordinate mapping; respects active selection (clips writes); respects current mask/edit-target model (no wrong layer/mask writes); single pointer gesture = one atomic undoable history transaction; undo/redo restore exact pixels and layer state; save/reopen/recovery preserves edited pixels and document state; missing source handled visibly and safely (no silent pixel corruption). Clone source, aligned/unaligned, and coordinate relationship must be an explicit testable data model, not implicit UI-handler state. Reuse tiled stores and coordinate helpers; do not materialize entire canvas/layer for a clone operation. Add focused unit tests for source/destination pixel correctness, multi-segment aligned strokes, unaligned restart, transformed layers, selection clipping, masks/edit targets, tile-boundary behavior; add browser workflow using real pointer/keyboard events verifying undo/redo plus persistence/recovery. Do not regress existing Brush/Eraser behavior.
